AGO.note: Only the cross-border link and sea cable plans; no national backbone stated.

facts.fact: Angola Telecom's executive director said Angola Telecom and Telecom Namibia signed a memorandum of understanding in Swakopmund in March 2026 for the SARSSy submarine cable, with five Angolan landing points and a link to Equiano, due in service in June 2027.

Angola Telecom's executive director said a terrestrial fibre link between Angola (Santa Clara) and Namibia (Ondjiva) already exists and the two operators already provide telecom services in both directions.
